description: Onboarding UI + Stats surfacing. Create the mandatory, iOS-styled, emoji-free BmiStep with a live animated BMI gauge, wire it into OnboardingFlow between Exercise and Recommendation (TOTAL_STEPS=5) with advance-gating and rerun prefill, add all BMI/onboarding/stats copy and any needed icon, and add a guarded BMI card to Stats. Depends on FEAT-001 (ProfilingAnswers fields, bmi.ts validators/category) and FEAT-002 (BMI-aware recommendation so RecommendationStep reflects it automatically).
steps: In src/lib/copy.ts add a new typed `bmi` block and extend others, all Indonesian, casual Gojek voice, emoji-free: step title and intro; tinggi (cm) and berat (kg) input labels, units, numeric placeholders; friendly validation messages for out-of-range/empty height and weight (reference the 100-250 cm, 30-300 kg bounds in friendly wording); the four category labels (underweight/normal/overweight/obese) with a one-line friendly description each; and an honest disclaimer that BMI is a rough indicator (does not distinguish muscle vs fat) and Heula is not a substitute for medical advice. Also add any new copy.onboarding.* strings the step needs (e.g. a dedicated bmiQuestion) and the copy.stats.* strings for the Stats BMI card (label + per-category short text).

If BmiStep needs an icon not already in the IconKey union, add the new key to the IconKey union in src/types/index.ts AND add the mapping in src/components/ui/Icon.tsx using a VERIFIED react-icons/io5 name (e.g. IoBodyOutline for a body/BMI glyph). Prefer reusing existing keys where sensible. Never import react-icons outside Icon.tsx.

Create src/features/onboarding/BmiStep.tsx ("use client"), following the ExerciseStep/GoalStep structure (h1 title from copy, body, Button footer with ghost Back + primary Lanjut). Props: `heightCm: number | null`, `weightKg: number | null`, `onHeightChange(cm: number | null)`, `onWeightChange(kg: number | null)`, `onNext`, `onBack`. Two labelled numeric inputs with inputMode (numeric for cm, decimal for kg), min/max from bmi.ts bounds, >=44px touch targets, visible focus states, aria-label/aria-describedby tying inputs to their validation messages. Show friendly Indonesian validation text when a value is present but invalid. Compute live BMI via computeBmi + bmiCategory from @/lib/bmi; render the numeric BMI value, the category label, and the friendly one-liner. The primary Lanjut button is disabled until isValidBmiInput(height, weight) is true.

Build the attractive LIVE BMI visualization inside BmiStep using divs/SVG + brand/semantic tokens + motion/react (NO chart library, NO emoji): a horizontal segmented colored scale with four segments (underweight/normal/overweight/obese) and a marker/needle that animates to the user's BMI position via a motion spring. Use existing Tailwind tokens from globals.css (brand/brand-soft for the safe/normal zone, danger for obese, muted tones for underweight/overweight); ensure it reads cleanly in BOTH light and dark. Position the marker by mapping BMI onto a sensible display range (e.g. clamp 15-35) so boundaries at 18.5/23/25 line up with segment edges. Include the disclaimer line (emoji-free) near the bottom.

Wire BmiStep into src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx: set TOTAL_STEPS = 5; the draft heightCm/weightKg state already added in FEAT-001 is reused here; insert <BmiStep> at index 3 so the order is Welcome(0) -> Goal(1) -> Exercise(2) -> BMI(3) -> Recommendation(4); the inline RecommendationStep `answers` and the handleConfirm `answers` literal must now carry the real draft heightCm/weightKg. Gate advancement: the BMI step's onNext/goNext must be blocked until isValidBmiInput(heightCm, weightKg) (the step's own Lanjut disabled covers this; also guard goNext from the BMI index). In rerun mode (searchParams rerun===1), prefill heightCm/weightKg from the persisted profiling via the store if present (read profiling once and seed the useState initializers or a useEffect-free initial value). Keep the existing Stepper total={TOTAL_STEPS} and the motion horizontal spring slide. Do NOT reintroduce `custom` into RecommendationStep's selectable list.

Verify RecommendationStep reflects BMI automatically: it already calls recommendMethod(answers) and renders rec.warning in a banner, so the FEAT-002 underweight caring note surfaces with no markup change. Confirm by manual reasoning + build; do not alter RecommendationStep unless a type error requires it.

In src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx add a compact BMI card near the existing goal card: read heightCm/weightKg from the stored profiling; GUARD for undefined/invalid (older persisted profiling predates BMI) using isValidBmiInput — if invalid, DO NOT render the card (never crash). When valid, show the computed BMI value + category label + short friendly text from copy.stats.*, styled compactly to match the goal Card. Apply the same undefined-guard anywhere profiling.heightCm/weightKg is read.
acceptance_criteria: A new mandatory BMI step renders between Exercise and Recommendation; Stepper shows 5 dots and the user cannot advance past BMI without a valid height and weight.
BmiStep shows a live numeric BMI, category label, friendly one-liner, an animated segmented gauge, and the rough-indicator / not-medical-advice disclaimer, all emoji-free and clean in light and dark.
RecommendationStep reflects the BMI-adjusted recommendation automatically, including the underweight caring note when applicable.
Rerun mode (?rerun=1) also passes through the BMI step and prefills stored height/weight when present.
Stats shows a BMI card for profiling with valid height/weight and HIDES it (no crash) for older profiling lacking those fields.
All icons go through Icon.tsx; any new IconKey is added to the union and mapped with a verified io5 name.
`npm run build` succeeds, `npx vitest run` passes (including the no-emoji scan), and `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean with no `any`.
findings:
DONE. tsc --noEmit clean (no any); full suite 185 passed (was 184 after FEAT-002; +1 is the no-emoji scan picking up the new BmiStep.tsx file, now 70 scanned files all green); npm run build succeeds. The single eslint warning (_exhaustive unused in recommendation.ts) is pre-existing from FEAT-002, not introduced here.

copy.ts: added a typed `bmi` block (stepTitle, stepIntro, height/weight labels+units+placeholders, heightInvalid/weightInvalid referencing the 100-250cm & 30-300kg bounds in friendly wording, resultLabel, the four category labels underweight/normal/overweight/obese + a one-line friendly desc each, and the honest rough-indicator / not-medical-advice disclaimer). Extended copy.onboarding with `bmiQuestion`. Extended copy.stats with `bmiLabel` + four per-category short texts (bmiUnderweight/bmiNormal/bmiOverweight/bmiObese). All Indonesian Gojek voice, emoji-free.

Icon.tsx + types/index.ts: added IconKey `bmi` to the union and mapped it to the VERIFIED io5 glyph IoBodyOutline (confirmed present via require('react-icons/io5')). No react-icons import outside Icon.tsx.

src/features/onboarding/BmiStep.tsx (CREATE, 'use client'): follows ExerciseStep/GoalStep structure (h1 from copy, body, ghost Back + primary Lanjut footer). Props exactly heightCm/weightKg (number|null), onHeightChange/onWeightChange (number|null), onNext, onBack. Two labelled numeric inputs: height inputMode='numeric', weight inputMode='decimal', min/max from bmi.ts bounds, min-h-12 (>=44px) targets, focus-within:border-brand visible focus, aria-label + aria-invalid + aria-describedby tying each input to its validation message (useId). Friendly Indonesian validation text shows only when a value is present but out-of-range (isValidHeight/isValidWeight). Live BMI via computeBmi+bmiCategory: renders numeric bmi.toFixed(1), category label pill, and the friendly one-liner. Lanjut disabled until isValidBmiInput(height,weight). SSR-safe: no window usage; empty-string<->null parsing via a pure parseField.

Gauge: a horizontal 4-segment colored scale (divs with flex-basis % computed from the Asia-Pacific BMI spans mapped onto a clamped 15-35 display range so edges land at 18.5/23/25) using brand tokens — content-muted/35 (underweight), brand (normal/safe), brand-soft (overweight), danger (obese). A motion/react spring-animated marker (absolute, left %) needles to the user's BMI position. No chart library, no emoji; reads cleanly in light + dark (all semantic tokens). Disclaimer line rendered near the bottom.

OnboardingFlow.tsx: TOTAL_STEPS=5; added BMI_STEP=3 index const. Order Welcome(0)->Goal(1)->Exercise(2)->BMI(3)->Recommendation(4) by inserting <BmiStep> wired to the existing heightCm/weightKg draft state + setters (added in FEAT-001). goNext now hard-gates at BMI_STEP: returns early unless isValidBmiInput(heightCm??NaN, weightKg??NaN) (belt-and-braces on top of the step's disabled Lanjut). Rerun prefill: reads store profiling once; when ?rerun=1 the useState initializers seed goal/exercises/intensity/heightCm/weightKg from the persisted profiling (no useEffect, no hydration mismatch since the same source is read on first render). Both ProfilingAnswers literals (handleConfirm + inline RecommendationStep answers) already carry the real draft heightCm/weightKg (as number). Did NOT reintroduce `custom` into RecommendationStep's selectable list.

RecommendationStep.tsx: NOT modified — it already calls recommendMethod(answers) and renders rec.warning in a banner, so the FEAT-002 underweight caring note (delivered via warning) and overweight/obese framing (in rationale) surface automatically. Confirmed by build + reasoning.

StatsOverview.tsx: added a compact BMI Card next to the goal card, matched to its layout (pill icon slot + label/value). Reads profiling?.heightCm/weightKg; guards with heightCm!==undefined && weightKg!==undefined && isValidBmiInput(...) so older profiling lacking BMI fields renders NOTHING (never crashes). When valid, shows bmi.toFixed(1) + per-category short text from copy.stats.*. Same undefined-guard applied at the single read site.

FEAT-003 complete; no follow-ups required.
